newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Renong in electronic card plan for transport fares.
newsitem.headline: Renong in electronic card plan for transport fares.

text.p: Malaysian conglomerate Renong Bhd and a number of its associate companies plans to develop an electronic payment system for the paying of transport fares.
In a statement issued by Commerce International Merchant Bankers Bhd, the companies said they plan to establish a central clearing house for the planned smartcard. No further details were given.

Companies involved in the plan include 38 percent owned engineering firm United Engineers (M) Bhd, 50.1 percent controlled bus operator Park May Bhd, construction group Intria Bhd, 19.9 percent owned financial firm Commerce Asset-holding Bhd and Teras Teknologi Sdn Bhd.
United Engineers holds a 23.9 percent equity interest in Intria while Renong holds a 70 percent stake in private firm Teras.
